title: Camp Cale

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: The DRAGONFLY Day Camp and FIREFLY Day Camp are both day camp programs offered by Camp Cale for kids who aren’t quite ready for overnight stays but still want to enjoy the camp experience. Also see our Specialty Camp for other Day Camp opportunities during Spring Break! Age Group: 6-8 years old - Your child must have COMPLETED kindergarten and be 6 years old by June 1st, 2027 in order to attend our Dragonfly Day Camp week. Purpose: Introduces younger campers to Camp Cale in a safe, fun, age-appropriate day setting. Purpose: Designed for slightly older kids to experience Camp Cale’s activities without staying

blurb: Situated on 111 acres along the beautiful Perquimans River, Camp Cale, a ministry of the Chowan Baptist Association, has been making an impact through camp ministry since 1961. From humble beginnings, we've grown into a vibrant camp and conference center.
